incident.requiredRule: Y6TnMm must render term-first then lesson-number; Y6SMn/Y6MSn must render numerically.
rootCauseChain: The September standalone visible-code DOM sorter was the last owner-proven working mechanism.
The 2026-10-01 nested Year 6 Lessons/SATS change created a Lessons path that bypassed the old sorter.
The 2026-10-02 V2 rebuild removed the old standalone sorter from the rebuilt frontend.
Initial 2026-10-04 repairs were deployed only to GitHub Pages, but the live hostname is intercepted by a Cloudflare Browser Worker route, so those Pages assets were not the live production surface.

historicalWorkingMechanism.contract: Standalone script explicitly loaded by index.html, sorting browser-visible lesson rows by visible display code, reapplying with MutationObserver, and cache-busting the corrected script.

preservedLaterFrontend.proof: Canonical source/live-v2-current src/app.js is byte-for-byte identical to the exact source used by the successful 2026-10-02 live Browser Worker asset deployment.
preservedLaterFrontend.preservation: Nested Year 6 Lessons/SATS navigation, dedicated maths-sats route, 11+-only Year 6 exclusions, Maths Practice and all other accepted V2 application behavior remain in the unchanged base app source.

checks: Exact Oct 2 V2 application source identity
Standalone guard source and cache-busted loader
Exact owner failure shape Y6T1M01 -> Y6T1M17 -> Y6T1M02 corrected to Y6T1M01 -> Y6T1M02 -> Y6T1M17
Post-render DOM scramble automatically repaired by MutationObserver
SATS numeric order Y6SM1 -> Y6SM2 -> Y6SM10

liveTopology.authoritativeServingRule: Cloudflare Browser Worker ASSETS is the live frontend serving path while this route is active; GitHub Pages alone is not a live deployment.

productionDeployment.workflow: Deploy canonical live V2 Browser assets
liveChecks: Production Browser Worker runtime/topology matched guarded baseline before mutation.
ASSETS and STAGING_API bindings were preserved after deployment.
Live hostname served the exact locally-built core bundle.
Live hostname served the standalone Year 6 guard and its marker.
Stable public recheck passed after propagation.

repositoryCleanup.rule: Superseded Pages-only/pre-render/in-bundle Year 6 fix workflows and branches are not authority and are removed from the canonical source path; the exact Oct 2 app plus standalone guard is the only current frontend repair.
repositoryCleanup.pagesFallback: GitHub Pages fallback is synchronized from the same canonical source, but is not the live serving path while the Browser Worker route remains active.

completionGate: Do not mark CLOSED PASS until the owner refreshes the authenticated live portal and confirms the visible Year 6 order is correct.
